user.title: Connect a GridZeno dongle
user.description: Usually Home Assistant finds the dongle on your network by itself. If it does not, type its address here. You find it on the Dongle page in GridZeno.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Connect GridZeno {device_id}?
zeroconf_confirm.description: Home Assistant found the GridZeno dongle {device_id} at {host}. Next, Home Assistant shows a six-digit code, and you approve the connection in GridZeno.

reauth_confirm.title: Connect GridZeno {device_id} again
reauth_confirm.description: The dongle no longer knows this Home Assistant: the access was removed, or the dongle was paired to another account. Connect it again and approve it in GridZeno.

error.cannot_connect: The dongle did not answer at that address.
error.not_a_dongle: Something answered, but not a GridZeno dongle.

abort.already_configured: This dongle is already connected. Its address has been updated.
abort.not_a_dongle: This is not a GridZeno dongle.
abort.unsupported_api: The dongle speaks a newer version of the local API. Update the GridZeno integration in HACS.
abort.no_room: Four Home Assistants are already connected to this dongle. Remove one in GridZeno first.
abort.too_many: The dongle has had too many requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.
abort.pairing_failed: The key exchange with the dongle failed. Something on the network may be in the way. Try again.
abort.denied: The connection was refused in GridZeno.
abort.expired: The request ran out before it was approved. Try again.
abort.another_dongle: Another dongle answered at that address.

release.name: Give the inverter its own settings back

unknown_entry.message: That is not a GridZeno dongle in this Home Assistant.

read_only.message: This Home Assistant may only read. Give it the right to control in GridZeno (connect it again and choose read and control).

not_authorized.message: The dongle no longer knows this Home Assistant. Connect it again.

bad_answer.message: The dongle's answer could not be trusted (no valid signature). Try again; if it keeps happening, something on the network may be in the way.

refused_auto_mode.message: GridZeno controls the plant. Choose to control it yourself under Automation in GridZeno first.

refused_scope.message: This Home Assistant may only read.

refused_not_paired.message: The dongle does not belong to a GridZeno account.

refused_export_limit_not_writable.message: GridZeno may not change the export limit on this inverter.

refused_commands_disabled.message: Control from Home Assistant is not switched on on this dongle yet.

refused_target_soc_out_of_range.message: The target is outside the battery limits you set in GridZeno.

refused_power_out_of_range.message: The power is outside what the inverter can do.

refused_floor_out_of_range.message: The floor is outside the battery limits you set in GridZeno.

refused_control_not_allowed.message: The dongle does not control this inverter: GridZeno has not released control of the model, or the inverter is not the model chosen.

refused_mode_not_supported.message: This inverter cannot do that command.

refused_duration_out_of_range.message: The duration must be 15 minutes to 12 hours.

dongle_api_newer.title: GridZeno {device_id} needs a newer integration
dongle_api_newer.description: The dongle speaks version {dongle_api} of its local API, and this integration knows version {integration_api}. Update the GridZeno integration in HACS. Until then, some values may be missing.

dongle_api_older.title: GridZeno {device_id} needs new firmware
dongle_api_older.description: The dongle speaks version {dongle_api} of its local API, and this integration expects version {integration_api}. The dongle updates itself from GridZeno; if it does not, write to GridZeno's support.

charge_from_grid.name: Charge from the grid
charge_from_grid.description: Charges the battery from the grid to a target, for a time. Needs you to control the plant yourself.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Stops by itself after this many minutes.

hold_battery.name: Hold the battery
hold_battery.description: Keeps the battery as it is: the house uses the sun and the grid. Needs you to control the plant yourself.

duration.name: Duration

sell_from_battery.name: Sell from the battery
sell_from_battery.description: Sells from the battery with a power, down to a floor. Needs you to control the plant yourself.

floor_soc.name: Floor
floor_soc.description: Stop at this level (default: your minimum in GridZeno).

limit_export.name: Limit selling to the grid
limit_export.description: Sets the inverter's export limit for a time; 0 stops selling. Needs you to control the plant yourself.

export_limit.description: At most this share of the inverter's power.
